info.name: PayMock Gateway API Collection
info.description: PayMock API collection. metadata is optional and accepts any valid JSON value; the Gateway does not inspect, validate, or rewrite metadata and passes it through unchanged. Idempotency-Key is optional and is the only way to deduplicate POST /v1/payments; without it each request creates a new payment. The header is internal and is not returned in API responses or webhook bodies. expires_in is optional for both card and PromptPay (minimum 60 seconds, default 600). The paymock_scheduler checks pending payments every 10 seconds; after expires_at passes, EXPIRED is normally recorded within the next scheduler run. GET /v1/payments/{id} only reads stored status.
